title: Resistors from two suppliers
intro: A buyer measured 500 nominal 100 Ω resistors from each of two suppliers. Supplier 1: mean 100.12 Ω, standard deviation 1.05 Ω. Supplier 2: mean 99.98 Ω, standard deviation 1.10 Ω. The resistors are rated ±5 % (±5 Ω). Welch's t-test at α = 0.05 finds the difference statistically significant, but the confidence interval and Cohen's d show it is far too small to matter for a ±5 Ω part.
